scope: Exact same-ID/prompt/arrival/source/pair comparisons within each final start block. Six observed host-path differences add to mean client-TTFT difference. They do not decompose TTFTp95. Prepare is a host boundary,not a GPU start. C3 prepare-to-ready includes chunk packing and other requests. Post-first-output residency is separate and is not added to TTFT. Natural actual output lengths can differ. Pointwise absolute-difference CIs resample paired server starts. Stage CIs do not add to a TTFT CI. Configured credits,compile families and D policies remain explicit. This does not isolate GPU operator causality.
